notes.title: Dual Wield, Boss and many other things added!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Today I bring another update on the progress of Maidenless!

I have been working on fixing all the bugs and cleaning everything up ready for a release soon!

In the meantime here are some more gifs that show some of the progress I have been making with different mechanics.

I have decided to add a boss to the game as something for people to do when they don't feel like PvPing or if there are no other players currently online.
The Boss can be fought solo or with friends and can also spawn in one of the arena maps during PvP to spice things up a little bit.

Hopefully after a little more testing this week Maidenless will be ready for an initial re-launch on steam and everyone can play!

Remember to join my discord to stay up to date and ask any questions you may have!
https://discord.gg/nkpSH5pt

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Today I bring you a small development update on the current state of Maidenless and how close we potentially are to a live public test!

I have been working pretty much non-stop in my free time adding and refining features to make sure when I do release to the public that it goes as flawlessly as possible.

So without wasting too much more time here are some new things that I have been working on!
Enjoy :D

Weapon Arts have been added as well as the logic behind stats, equipment and weights.

Preview of Weapon Arts

Customisation has also come quite a long way including the addition of rings and ring effects!

notes.title: New Direction for Maidenless and a public test coming soon!
notes.notes:
So after a long time away I am finally back, I won't bore you with the details since we all know how life goes but the short of it is I'm back and I've been a little busy behind the scenes so let's jump into it! 

[u][h1][b]First the name change [/b][/h1][/u]

I am finally committing to the working title and renaming the game from Project: Maidenless to simply Maidenless.
With that out of the way let's move on to the interesting stuff.


[u][h1][b]Gameplay refocus [/b][/h1][/u]

Project Maidenless initially set out to be a dark fantasy souls like/Escape from Tarkov style extract game, while that concept still intrigues me it will no longer be the direction of Maidenless. 

[u][b]The reason [/b][/u]

After a lot of thought I came to the realisation that during live testing I actually had the most fun in the Arena mode and that the more simple "load up and fight" game play loop appealed to me more in this current climate of chore heavy games. 

So based on that I decided to wipe the slate and start from scratch with the focus purely on the Arena. 

And with that in mind let's shift to what that means for Maidenless moving forward. 

[h1][u][b]The concept [/b][/u][/h1]

Maidenless will be an arena pvp game with Souls-like combat.
There will be multiple weapon types and various armour options to help customise your preferred play-style whether that be unga bunga with a big club or a ranged caster with a focus on aiding your allies, I plan to make build diversity a focus point! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326966/293b82d2607ec5adf0822d014231903c52105cb9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326966/4b6816204bc2792b505a3248332e6176d6dda68f.png[/img]

Player equipment, skills and attributes will be freely changeable between matches so you can always try something new or switch your build to fit what your team needs.
I will do a deep dive on all the features available in relation to character builds and playstyles at a later date! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326966/5f796686ef9599735458182efe76e95a819afd7c.png[/img]

As for gamemodes you can expect the tried and tested 1v1s, 2v2s 3v3s and free for all deathmatch. 

Some objective based modes like King of the Hill and capture the flag my be added at a later date based on interest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42326966/24eca6f45243edd37458025a8e92e133edced370.gif[/img]

Now moving on to matters of business


[h1][u][b]Price increase [/b][/u][/h1]

After development initially slowed for Maidenless I lowered the price to $1 because I did not feel the original asking price matched the level of content provided and I could not guarantee continued development.
However with this new direction and momentum I have decided to raise the price of Maidenless to $10.
I will be offering free and open testing of the alpha version when it is ready so anyone unsure will still be able to test the game and see if its something they are interested in!


Now as for when you can expect to play Maidenless that is still up for debate, however there will be a beta branch available for testing on steam soon that thus far has been open only to a few select people so keep an eye out for that! 

This initial testing build will have limited features and is currently focused purely on melee combat to refine the experience as much as possible before I move onto ranged and magic. 
The current game-mode available is just a simple free-for-all, someone creates a lobby and anyone can join and begin fighting and finding bugs!

Please keep in mind I am a solo developer who also works full-time so do not expect massive leaps in content very quickly. 

Thank you for taking the time to read this and a big thank you for supporting Maidenless 

I hope to see you in the arena soon! 

-Gaandi

notes.title: Price Change!
notes.notes:
Today I am reducing the price of Project: Maidenless by a considerable amount!

The reason for this change is I can not put the same amount of time into the development as I would like
But I still want people to be able to enjoy the game and the current price just doesn't reflect the quality of the product I am pushed out.

Please enjoy!

notes.title: Project: Maidenless is now in Early Access!
notes.notes:
Project: Maidenless is now in Early Access!
Download and play now!

I am very excited to see all your feedback, screenshots, bug-reports and hate mail.
Most of all I can't wait to see you in the Arena!

Join our Official Discord to stay up to date on news, updates and sneak peeks into future content.
https://discord.gg/TjMVu7C2tQ

Please remember this is very Early Access and primarily focused on the PvP Arena at this stage.
The PvE and Co-op content is purely a preview of what that side of the game might look like in the future and serves more as a place to practise or mess around in with friends or while the Matchmaking servers are low pop.

I am aware of some bugs in this current build that I am working hard to fix asap!
One of the most noticeable is probably the flashing or non-existent health bars above enemy heads :(

Thank you for understanding!

notes.title: 0.2 Combat Alpha!
notes.notes:

Good luck and we hope you enjoy Project: Maidenless as much as we do.
